sentences.text: Constellate computed that fucosidosis and alpha-mannosidosis have a moderately similar symptom profile, with a score of 0.207 over 20 shared terms, ranked 6 of 9 [e_eca78a94ecb3].
This link is inferred, meaning Constellate calculated it, and it is not a database finding [e_eca78a94ecb3].
Curated databases tie the two diseases to different genes, FUCA1 for fucosidosis and MAN2B1 for alpha-mannosidosis [e_f43fb134f2f7] [e_d7440f028524].
Alpha-mannosidosis has one recruiting study of a drug called velmanase alfa in young children and one earlier study of the same drug that was withdrawn [e_14334716209a] [e_3c267533a8ab].

Two patient groups are linked to it, the International Society for Mannosidosis and Related Diseases by an automatic name match, and the German MPS society by a text-mined link that is unverified [e_32aa33e96409] [e_2818cbae40f1].

For fucosidosis, coarse facial features are curated as very frequent, but that edge carries contradicting evidence, and a skull size abnormality is marked as contradicted [e_b79174fc4e22] [e_07b4fda8e15a].
These edges do not show that the study of alpha-mannosidosis applies to fucosidosis, and they do not show the drug works [e_14334716209a] [e_eca78a94ecb3].
